data.label: Change-request form
data.description: The controlled form used to raise a change request: description, justification, risk classification, impact assessment, implementation plan, independent approval and effectiveness verification.

sections.label: Change identification
sections.hint: Change number, title, initiator, and date raised.

sections.label: Description of change
sections.hint: Current state → proposed state, in concrete terms.

sections.label: Reason / justification
sections.hint: Why the change is needed and what triggered it.

sections.label: Classification & risk
sections.hint: Minor / major / critical, with the risk rationale.

sections.label: Impact assessment
sections.hint: Effect on product, process, equipment, validation state, and regulatory filings.

sections.label: Affected documents & records
sections.hint: SOPs, specifications, validation protocols, and linked deviations / CAPAs.

sections.label: Implementation plan
sections.hint: Actions, owners, target dates, and any pre-approval conditions.

sections.label: Approval
sections.hint: Independent review and approval — the approver must differ from the initiator.

sections.label: Implementation & verification
sections.hint: Confirmation the change was implemented as approved and the effectiveness check.

sections.label: Closure
sections.hint: Final sign-off closing the change record.
